subject: BrightBridge pilot: model roster, acceptance metrics & action items
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex@brightbridge.com>, Susan Liu <susan.liu@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: pilot scope & proposed model shortlist + next steps

Hi Alex / Susan — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and the concrete next steps we discussed so we have alignment before the kickoff. Attaching a short POC scope doc and our security appendix.

High-level objective
- Validate integration of Redwood inference into BrightBridge customer support flow (automated reply suggestions + triage).

Success criteria (customer-facing acceptance)
- Intent accuracy >= 88% on your annotated eval set (priority intents: refund, shipping, account help)
- Response relevance QA score >= 4.0/5 on sampled transcripts
- Translation quality (ES/PT) not to degrade intent accuracy more than 5 percentage points vs. en baseline
- Latency p95 <= 600ms for single-request inference in the pilot config

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Kickoff: week of Sep 22 (proposed)
- Week 1: integration + ingest eval prompts (BrightBridge provides ~1k labeled examples)
- Week 2: run baseline models and collect metrics; weekly checkpoint with BrightBridge on Wed
- Week 3: finalize acceptance tests and handoff recommendations
- Total trial: 3 weeks (can extend based on results)

Model shortlist (pilot roster) — proposed baseline + fallback
1) Llama 2 13B (quantized q8_0) — baseline for balanced quality/cost
2) Mistral 7B (8-bit) — low-latency candidate for high-throughput endpoints
3) Redwood-instruct-3B — fallback for isolated low-cost runs / ephemeral scale-outs
Notes: we will run bilingual evals for Spanish/Portuguese and include prompt templates that mirror your support utterances.

Ownership & immediate asks
- Ben Carter (technical lead) — infra config, eval harness, metrics capture
- Monica Patel (CS) — data collection, access to sample transcripts, acceptance test coordination
- Me (Marissa) — commercial lead, timeline and approval for the pilot and contract/credits

Immediate actions for BrightBridge
- Please share the labeled eval set (or a representative sample) and any data residency constraints by Sep 18
- Confirm kickoff week of Sep 22 or propose alternate date
- Review the attached POC scope and sign the mutual action plan (I’ll send DocuSign link once you confirm)

Attachments: BrightBridge-POC-scope.pdf, redwood-security-appendix.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all — adding some technical detail so BrightBridge knows what we’ll run in week 2 and what we need from your side.

Suggested pilot stack
- Run Llama 2 13B q8_0 as the baseline. It gives the best balance for instruction-following on support prompts.
- Mistral 7B (8-bit) as a secondary candidate focused on latency-sensitive endpoints (we’ll measure p50/p95).
- Redwood-instruct-3B as cost-efficient fallback and comparison point.

Evaluation harness & metrics (what we’ll produce)
- Intent precision/recall and macro F1 (targets: precision >= 0.88 on priority intents)
- Response relevance judged by a 5-point rubric (we’ll provide simple annotation UI for blind reviews)
- Translation checks: compute BLEU + chrF against your Spanish sample; also measure impact on intent F1
- Latency & throughput profiling: p50/p95 per model under 8 concurrent users and under 50 concurrent users

Infra/config asks from BrightBridge
- Access to a staging endpoint or S3 folder with sample transcripts (read-only)
- Any IP/data-handling requirements; if EU residency is mandatory we can run in eu-west with our private-data routing (we’ll scope the Private deployment add-on)

Deliverables by end of week 2
- Evaluation spreadsheet (attached) with model-by-metric breakdown
- Short tech readout (1 page) with recommended production model and fallbacks

Attachment: evaluation-metrics.xlsx

I’ll prepare a minimal infra playbook for the kickoff runbook and post it to the shared Drive link.

—
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
